summary: Pause a flowing Readable without discarding newly arriving data.

target.notes: Switch flowing streams out of flowing mode, keep incoming data buffered, return the same stream, and preserve the documented no-effect behavior when a 'readable' listener controls consumption.

semantics.readable_listener: pause has no effect in readable-listener mode

caveats: Pausing emission is not equivalent to stopping the underlying producer immediately; buffering/backpressure remain runtime concerns.

tests.name: paused data is buffered
tests.input: const {PassThrough}=require('node:stream'); const r=new PassThrough(); const out=[]; r.on('data',x=>out.push(x.toString())); r.pause(); r.write('x'); console.log(out.length); r.resume();
tests.expected_behavior: prints 0 before resume; x is delivered after resume
